policy.closure_rule: An action closes only when its named evidence satisfies its pass condition; implementation or ticket closure alone is insufficient.

actions.title: Version the incident observation and evidence manifest schema
actions.artifact: reviewed incident schema with user-impact, database, topology, backup and business fields

verification.procedure: validate one historical evidence bundle and one packet with a required field removed
verification.pass_condition: the complete bundle passes and the incomplete packet fails before a response route is selected
verification.evidence_to_close: validator output, schema revision and review record

actions.failure_condition: a responder can select a destructive route while required identity or impact fields are absent

actions.title: Enforce exact target and production approval on destructive workflows
actions.artifact: policy gate for target identity, traffic, data class, authority and rollback

verification.procedure: submit missing, conflicting and production-valued guard combinations in a disposable control test
verification.pass_condition: every unsafe combination fails before remote mutation and emits a reviewable reason
verification.evidence_to_close: guard matrix, exit codes and zero-mutation capture

actions.failure_condition: a generic confirmation token can authorize an unresolved or production target

actions.title: Define idempotency tokens and unknown-outcome reconciliation
actions.artifact: request identity contract and reconciliation query or API

verification.procedure: interrupt acknowledgements around commit and reconcile every attempt by stable token
verification.pass_condition: no acknowledged result is missing, no token is duplicated and every unknown result becomes resolved
verification.evidence_to_close: attempt ledger, database manifest and reconciliation report

actions.failure_condition: the system asks operators to infer commit outcome from client timeout alone

actions.title: Separate user-impact SLI from diagnostic database telemetry
actions.artifact: versioned SLI specification, dashboard and page policy

verification.procedure: inject a synthetic user failure and an isolated diagnostic anomaly as separate cases
verification.pass_condition: user failure pages from the SLI while the diagnostic-only anomaly remains contextual evidence
verification.evidence_to_close: time-series query, alert evaluation and notification trace

actions.failure_condition: a host or PostgreSQL metric is treated as user impact without an explicit service mapping

actions.title: Run PITR candidate selection with business-delta reconciliation
actions.artifact: quarterly PITR drill and business reconciliation manifest

verification.procedure: restore at least two candidate targets, reject the wrong history and reconcile legitimate post-target facts
verification.pass_condition: selected history, lineage and all versioned business invariants pass without business cutover
verification.evidence_to_close: candidate manifests, source audit, timing decomposition and retained backup identity

actions.failure_condition: restore success is accepted from PostgreSQL startup or row count alone

actions.title: Exercise fencing, failover, outcome reconciliation and rejoin

verification.procedure: prove old-writer fencing, promotion authority, client outcomes, timeline lineage and replica rejoin
verification.pass_condition: one writer is accepted, every client token is reconciled and the restored topology matches the declared baseline
verification.evidence_to_close: DCS projection, timeline graph, client ledger and before-after topology

actions.failure_condition: a promoted endpoint is accepted without proof that the old writer cannot retain authority

actions.title: Deploy separate flow-pressure and retention-pressure decision routes
actions.artifact: headroom dashboard, alert projection and evidence-based classifier

verification.procedure: classify flow, WAL retention, XID retention and ambiguous evidence packets without scenario labels
verification.pass_condition: known predicates select scoped routes and ambiguous packets stop without executing a wrong action
verification.evidence_to_close: blind packets, classifications, counterexample report and alert links

actions.failure_condition: one generic resource alert maps directly to cancellation, restart or file deletion

actions.title: Schedule integrity evidence and clone-only rescue exercises
actions.artifact: checksum, amcheck and collation review policy plus forensic clone runbook

verification.procedure: distinguish physical and derived corruption, preserve originals and recover on separate working copies
verification.pass_condition: physical, structural and business checks pass on recovery copies while original evidence hashes remain unchanged
verification.evidence_to_close: checksum output, amcheck report, collation dependency list, hashes and business manifest

actions.failure_condition: the only evidence copy is changed or a clean checksum is treated as proof of business correctness

actions.title: Put Pigsty inventory and dangerous playbook scope behind review
actions.artifact: reviewed inventory workflow, pinned release and safeguard policy

verification.procedure: submit drift, an unbounded limit and a disabled safeguard as separate review fixtures
verification.pass_condition: desired-state drift is visible and every unsafe playbook fixture is blocked before execution
verification.evidence_to_close: review checks, rendered diff, exact inventory target and policy decision

actions.failure_condition: a destructive or broad playbook can run without exact inventory and explicit review

actions.title: Revise SLO, RPO, RTO, capacity and security assumptions from measured evidence
actions.artifact: approved SLO policy and architecture decision record

verification.procedure: trace every numeric objective to a production measurement or explicitly bounded drill
verification.pass_condition: no sandbox timing is promoted to an SLO and every objective has a measurement and breach response
verification.evidence_to_close: ADR, SLI queries, recovery drill distribution and approval record

actions.failure_condition: an objective is copied from a single lab run or vendor default without workload evidence

actions.title: Review cross-incident control themes and overdue evidence monthly
actions.artifact: control registry with recurrence, owner, evidence age and exception expiry

verification.procedure: query controls with overdue evidence, expired exceptions or repeated incident tags
verification.pass_condition: every result has a named decision owner and dated disposition; silent overdue items are zero
verification.evidence_to_close: registry export, review minutes and exception decisions

actions.failure_condition: postmortems are searchable documents but action status and evidence age cannot be aggregated

actions.title: Run a 90-day game day and independently verify control effectiveness
actions.artifact: blind cross-scenario game day and independent closure review

verification.procedure: draw an unlabeled scenario, require evidence-based routing, restore service and validate every claimed control
verification.pass_condition: the team reaches a safe route without hidden answers and an independent reviewer accepts every closure artifact
verification.evidence_to_close: scenario seed, timeline, decision log, recovery manifest and signed review

actions.failure_condition: the team succeeds only when told the scenario or action sequence in advance
